functionality.rationale: The current self-referential verified-SHA precondition prevents every schema-v4 task from completing acceptance after otherwise successful exact-candidate CI.

security.rationale: The repair must replace an impossible self-reference with exact candidate-commit binding without trusting mutable worktree state or weakening remote run and artifact validation.

performance.rationale: Collection adds bounded Git metadata and status reads once per schema-v4 acceptance.

compatibility.rationale: Integrated records intentionally keep verified_sha empty until acceptance, while accepted records and existing criterion bundles must retain their current validation contract.

concurrency.rationale: Acceptance waits on remote CI while sharing the integration worktree, so collection must reject any intervening checkout or dirty-state change.

platform.rationale: The repair uses portable Git plumbing and Python already required by the acceptance harness.

persistence.rationale: Criterion evidence becomes durable acceptance provenance, so its source record, workflow run, artifacts, and bundle must all bind one immutable candidate SHA.

adr.rationale: The task restores the approved exact-candidate acceptance order and changes no public contract or expensive-to-reverse architecture decision.

architecture.rationale: The change is confined to the internal criterion-evidence collector and its tests.

roadmap.rationale: The task unblocks governed delivery and adds no product behavior or milestone.

failure_fingerprints: FAILED: integrated candidate evidence requires no precommitted verified SHA

defect.symptom: Schema-v4 acceptance reports 'record integration does not bind the source SHA' after the exact delivery workflow and criterion evidence job both pass.
defect.expected_contract: Acceptance collects exact-candidate evidence while the delivery record is integrated with empty verified_sha, then mark-accepted binds that verified SHA and the generated bundle atomically.
defect.actual_behavior: Evidence collection requires verified_sha to equal the delivery commit SHA before mark-accepted, creating an impossible requirement for a commit to contain its own SHA.
defect.trigger: Run agent.sh accept for any integrated schema-v4 squash or cherry-pick delivery whose remote CI and criterion artifact succeed.
